blocks.text: PUERTO PRINCESA CITY— A police officer and a bystander died in a shooting incident at Sitio Marabahay, Barangay Rio Tuba in the Palawan town of Bataraza on Monday, the Bataraza Municipal Police Station said. The law enforcer, assigned to the 2nd Special Operations Unit of the PNP Maritime Group, discharged his government-issued firearm inside the police premises before noon, before he began roaming the street at Marabahay. Responding police officers tried to subdue the suspect, but he shot at them, prompting the responders to return fire.
